title: Shared primitive types
description: Types repeated across the per-event-type schemas (EVENT_SCHEMAS.md §2-§7). Defined once so a value set cannot drift between two event schemas. Enum members are transcribed from ENUMS.md; a contract test asserts they still match libs.enums.

uuid.description: UUID v4 — every internal entity primary key (ZIP_13 README, resolves Q29).

timestamptz.description: timestamptz, UTC, ISO-8601 on the wire (ZIP_13 README).

paise.description: Money: integer minor units (paise), currency fixed to INR for MVP (ZIP_13 README).
